chunks: Hadith 1412 — Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام used to supplicate in the qunut of the Witr with this supplication:
"O Allah, You created me with decree, arrangement, and insight, without negligence, and You brought me forth from

by Your power and strength. I engage with the world, then I contend with it, then I part from it. You gave me therein pasture and provision, and You made me perceive guidance therein; so excellent a Lord You are, and excellent a Master. O One who honored me, ennobled me, and blessed me, I seek refuge in You from Zaqqum, and I seek refuge in You from al-Hamim, and I seek refuge in You from a resting place in the Fire, among the layers of the Fire, in the shades of the Fire, on the Day of the Fire, O Lord of the Fire. O Allah, I ask You for a resting place in Paradise among its rivers, its trees, its fruits, its fragrant herbs, its servants, and its spouses. O Allah, I ask You for the best of good: Your good pleasure and Paradise; and I seek refuge in You from the worst of evil: Your wrath and the Fire. This is the station of one seeking refuge in You from the Fire, three times. O Allah, place Your fear in all of my body, and make my heart more intensely fearful of You than it is, and appoint for me in every day and night a share and portion of action in obedience to You and pursuit of Your good pleasure. O Allah, You are the utmost end of my goal, my hope, my request, and my seeking. I ask You, O my God, for the perfection of faith, the completion of certainty, the truthfulness of reliance upon You, and good opinion of You. O my Master, make my beneficence multiplied, my salat (prayer) humble supplication, my du'a (supplication) answered, my deed accepted, my effort appreciated, my sin forgiven, and teach me from You
And may Allah bless Muhammad and his family.

key_terms.الزَّقُّومِ: the infernal tree of Hell mentioned as a punishment
key_terms.الْحَمِيمِ: scalding or boiling fluid of Hell
key_terms.الْوَتْرِ: the Witr prayer, the odd-numbered prayer of the night prayer
key_terms.ظُلُمَاتٍ ثَلَاثٍ: the three darknesses from which the human being is brought forth
key_terms.قُنُوتِ: the supplicatory standing in salat (prayer), here in Witr

ai.seo_question: What du'a did Imam Ali عليه السلام recite in the qunut of Witr prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith preserves a supplication recited by Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام in the qunut of the Witr prayer. It combines acknowledgment of divine creation and guidance, seeking refuge from the Fire, longing for Paradise and Allah’s good pleasure, and asking for fear of Allah, complete faith, certainty, and acceptance of one's worship and deeds.
